cash_payment_active_uq.name: cash_payment_active_uq
cash_payment_active_uq.where: "cash_movement"."voided_at" is null and "cash_movement"."payment_id" is not null

cash_expense_active_uq.name: cash_expense_active_uq
cash_expense_active_uq.where: "cash_movement"."voided_at" is null and "cash_movement"."expense_id" is not null

cash_source_ck.name: cash_source_ck
cash_source_ck.value: num_nonnulls("cash_movement"."payment_id", "cash_movement"."expense_id", "cash_movement"."direct_cost_id", "cash_movement"."independent_loss_id") = 1 and (("cash_movement"."source_kind" = 'payment' and "cash_movement"."payment_id" is not null and "cash_movement"."direction" = 'in') or ("cash_movement"."source_kind" = 'expense' and "cash_movement"."expense_id" is not null and "cash_movement"."direction" = 'out') or ("cash_movement"."source_kind" = 'direct_cost' and "cash_movement"."direct_cost_id" is not null and "cash_movement"."direction" = 'out') or ("cash_movement"."source_kind" = 'independent_loss' and "cash_movement"."independent_loss_id" is not null and "cash_movement"."direction" = 'out'))

direct_cost_values_ck.name: direct_cost_values_ck
direct_cost_values_ck.value: "direct_cost"."amount" > 0 and ("direct_cost"."quantity" is null or "direct_cost"."quantity" >= 0) and ("direct_cost"."unit_cost" is null or "direct_cost"."unit_cost" >= 0)

expense_classification_ck.name: expense_classification_ck
expense_classification_ck.value: ("expense"."classification" = 'opex' and "expense"."cost_behavior" is not null and "expense"."cost_behavior" in ('fixed','variable')) or ("expense"."classification" = 'material_purchase' and "expense"."cost_behavior" is null)

order_closed_ck.name: order_closed_ck
order_closed_ck.value: ("order"."status" = 'closed' and "order"."closed_at" is not null and "order"."delivered_at" is not null) or ("order"."status" <> 'closed' and "order"."closed_at" is null)

order_confirmation_ck.name: order_confirmation_ck
order_confirmation_ck.value: ("order"."confirmed_at" is null and "order"."source_quote_id" is null and "order"."accepted_revision_id" is null and "order"."agreed_price" is null) or ("order"."confirmed_at" is not null and "order"."source_quote_id" is not null and "order"."accepted_revision_id" is not null and "order"."agreed_price" is not null and "order"."agreed_price" >= 0)

order_delivered_ck.name: order_delivered_ck
order_delivered_ck.value: ("order"."status" in ('delivered','closed') and "order"."delivered_at" is not null and "order"."confirmed_at" is not null) or ("order"."status" not in ('delivered','closed') and "order"."delivered_at" is null)

revision_values_ck.name: revision_values_ck
revision_values_ck.value: "quote_revision"."print_seconds" >= 0 and "quote_revision"."revision_number" > 0 and "quote_revision"."material_cost" >= 0 and "quote_revision"."energy_cost" >= 0 and "quote_revision"."machine_cost" >= 0 and "quote_revision"."contingency_cost" >= 0 and "quote_revision"."postprocess_cost" >= 0 and "quote_revision"."estimated_cost" >= 0 and ("quote_revision"."quoted_price" is null or "quote_revision"."quoted_price" >= 0)
